address: 5 Shuqi Road, Ruifang District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: For a glimpse of daily life in Taiwan in a bygone era, a trip to Jiufen Old Street is a must! Since the 1960s, this shop has been the place of choice for locals and tourists alike for sweet treats, such as dessert bowls with chewy taro balls made in-house, alongside assorted beans, either in piping hot red bean soup, or over shaved ice. Perched on a slope, the room affords gorgeous views of the valley and the sea – another reason to visit.
